meaning: Additional original API declarations flagged by the #215 assertion audit. Distinct from the 378 mapped domain declarations. Pending evidence is unblocked WS11-API work, not an unmerged service seam.

cases.rails_test: handoff_work denies a thread the agent does not own
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The MCP handoff requests survive the ownership-query control because the locked-row owner guard still rejects the write. The DB corpus fails by an unwrapped RecordNotFound, not the named HTTP denial assertion.

cases.rails_test: handoff_work denies a kill-switched receiver
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The first failures concern a missing/outside receiver, before the kill-switched receiver branch. No credit for the distinct suspended-receiver assertion.

cases.rails_test: handoff_work shares its throttle bucket with the rest endpoint
cases.reason: Production REST/MCP adapters and broad pinned bytes/state/queue vectors run, but a complete projection of this original declaration has not yet been individually audited; no broad vector is credited as its complete named assertion set.

cases.rails_test: is 404 for rooms the agent is not a member of
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: Failures concern missing work and a nonmember work update, not board POST/GET through a nonmember room.

cases.rails_test: rejects session and bot-key requests
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The recorded producer control was not exercised by these credited tests.

cases.rails_test: lists the board's open posts newest activity first
cases.reason: PR #215 assertion audit: The credited board REST corpus has one planned post; its shared model cap fixture has planned/blocked posts. The mixed open/done newest-activity output is not asserted.

cases.rails_test: a reply moves the post to the top of the list

cases.rails_test: lists by single status, done, and all
cases.reason: PR #215 assertion audit: The REST done-filter probe is empty because there are no done posts; the original positive done/all/open membership assertions do not run.

cases.rails_test: lists by owner me, agents, and id
cases.reason: PR #215 assertion audit: The REST fixture has one agent-owned post and no second agent or human-owned row; negative human filtering is covered, but the complete positive owner selection assertion set is not.

cases.rails_test: caps the list at 100 posts
cases.reason: PR #215 assertion audit: The credited wire fixture has one board post. The shared model cap assertion loads 100 work-list rows, but its board-post query filters to three rows. Neither assertion exercises the board-post 100-row cap.

cases.rails_test: a legacy agent without grants can list but cannot create
cases.reason: PR #215 assertion audit: No credited HTTP test couples a legacy no-grant successful list with its forbidden create request.

cases.rails_test: listing is 404 once the agent leaves the board
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The board-list failure is malformed-object room_id (mcp_posts_room_shape_3), not revoking a real board membership.

cases.reason: PR #215 assertion audit: The wire list has one owned thread; the cap fixture orders same-timestamp rows by ID. Different timestamp newest-first ordering and the original multi-row payload are not asserted.

cases.rails_test: list is Bearer-only and empty without owned threads
cases.reason: PR #215 assertion audit: The wire corpus does not issue the successful no-owned-threads list and the non-Bearer list request in this declaration.

cases.rails_test: show returns one owned thread

cases.rails_test: patch is 404 for threads the agent does not own
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The HTTP rejection is a foreign-owner request with empty arguments, exposing field validation. The valid-status DB write stops at the later owner guard as an unwrapped error, not the declared denial/state assertion.

cases.rails_test: patch is 403 when manage_threads covers another room

cases.rails_test: patch cannot reassign, convert, or stop tracking
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The recorded producer control was not exercised by these credited tests.

cases.rails_test: patch updates tags alone in array and string forms

cases.rails_test: patch cannot stop tracking with a blank status
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: Only unknown-status validation fails; all HTTP tests pass. The missing/blank-status stop-tracking branch is not rejected by these credited tests.

cases.rails_test: patch with only a note and no field is 422
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: Only an empty-field service update fails; the note-only HTTP request is absent from the credited tests.

cases.rails_test: patch tags without manage_threads is 403
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The first forbidden update has empty arguments; a tags-only request lacking manage_threads is not reached.

cases.rails_test: put result requires ownership and manage_threads
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The control exposes missing-markdown validation on a foreign-owner request. The valid result write still hits the model owner guard, not the declared ownership denial/state assertion.

cases.rails_test: put result rejects missing markdown and overlong results with 422
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The recorded producer control executed, but every credited test passed; it may be absorbed by another policy/validation guard or leave the asserted projection unchanged. A more discriminating comparison/control is required.

cases.rails_test: put result checks ownership and grants before markdown presence
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: Only the valid-owner missing-markdown case fails. Neither the foreign-owner nor forbidden-owner precedence assertion is exercised by that failure.

cases.rails_test: put result with blank markdown clears
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The rejected blank result starts with NULL. The credited fixtures do not perform the original successful set followed by clearing an existing nonempty result.

cases.rails_test: put result with unchanged markdown writes nothing
cases.reason: PR #215 systematic producer audit: The first rejected no-op is NULL-to-NULL. The original successful nonempty PUT followed by an identical nonempty PUT is absent from the credited fixtures.

cases.rails_test: patch and put result are Bearer-only

cases.rails_test: a read grant for another room does not unlock an owned thread
